blocks.subject: A grounded adult professional in a tailored charcoal blazer over a crisp white button-down, head-and-shoulders, one hand at chest level holding a slim fan of staggered index cards with a single card pulled forward at the front of the spread.
blocks.specialization: A hand-sorted fan of five manila index cards, the lead card nudged forward and annotated with a faint hand-drawn dependency arrow, the trailing cards stepped behind in a clear ranked order.
blocks.expression: A relaxed half-smile with the left corner of the mouth gently lifted, steady unhurried eyes, squared settled shoulders, chin level — the calm of someone who has already read the room and isn't waiting for anyone's approval.
blocks.crew_palette: A cool teal rim-light tracing the jawline and the far shoulder edge, and a small teal enamel collar pin on the left lapel — the only teal anywhere on the figure.
blocks.grade_cue: Four slim metallic rank bars stacked vertically on the right lapel and refined tailoring — sharp notch lapels, precise topstitching, and a clean sculpted shoulder line.
